g.text: Does Love separate from the proposed Mixson + Tyner group?

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172d43

g.text: Each symbol is one catalog ID in that evaluation. Green = same-group neighbor; orange = different-group neighbor.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172d43

g.text: Mixson + Tyner is a provisional grouping, not a verified species label. Upper Tyner is eligible here because it can match Mixson.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #758392

g.text: Dots show counts, not individual identities. The same specimens appear again in each method; these are not independent samples.
